mechanism: Minocycline is a tetracycline antibiotic that can cause photosensitivity and CNS effects; sacubitril (ARNI) combined with minocycline may increase risk of intracranial hypotension and dizziness, and minocycline may rarely cause autoimmune complications affecting cardiac stability.
action: Monitor blood pressure and orthostatic symptoms during concurrent use; counsel patient on photosensitivity precautions and CNS side effects; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
